title: Transcript count bounded by communication complexity
statement:
For every deterministic two-party communication protocol $p$ with input types $X$ and $Y$ and output type $\alpha$, the number of syntactic transcripts of $p$ is at most $2$ raised to its communication complexity:
\[
\abs{\mathrm{Transcript}(p)} \le 2^{\mathrm{complexity}(p)}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: p is a deterministic communication protocol over input types X, Y with output type alpha
replaced:
A deterministic protocol $p$ has at most $2^{\mathrm{complexity}(p)}$ syntactic
transcripts: $|\mathrm{Transcript}(p)| \le 2^{p.\mathrm{complexity}}$.
